mapper.select: SELECT N.*,U.USER_NM RGTR_NM,DATE_FORMAT(N.REG_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') REG_DT FROM notice_info N LEFT JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID=N.RGTR_ID WHERE AND (N.NOTICE_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') OR N.NOTICE_CN LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchKeyword},'%')) ORDER BY CASE WHEN N.NOTICE_SCOPE_CD='SYSTEM' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,N.NOTICE_SN DESC

SELECT N.*,U.USER_NM RGTR_NM,DATE_FORMAT(N.REG_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') REG_DT FROM notice_info N LEFT JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID=N.RGTR_ID WHERE AND N.POPUP_YN='Y' AND (N.BGNG_DT IS NULL OR N.BGNG_DT<=NOW()) AND (N.END_DT IS NULL OR N.END_DT>=NOW()) ORDER BY N.NOTICE_SN DESC LIMIT 10

mapper.update: UPDATE notice_info SET NOTICE_TITLE=#{noticeTitle},NOTICE_CN=#{noticeCn},POPUP_YN=IFNULL(#{popupYn},'Y'),BGNG_DT=NULLIF(#{bgngDt},''),END_DT=NULLIF(#{endDt},''),MDFCN_DT=NOW(),MDFR_ID=#{mdfrId} WHERE NOTICE_SN=#{noticeSn} AND NOTICE_SCOPE_CD='COMPANY' AND CO_ID=#{coId}
UPDATE notice_info SET USE_YN='N',MDFCN_DT=NOW(),MDFR_ID=#{mdfrId} WHERE NOTICE_SN=#{noticeSn} AND NOTICE_SCOPE_CD='COMPANY' AND CO_ID=#{coId}
